description: The Caribbean Institute for Meteorology and Hydrology (CIMH) in Barbados keeps an archive of meteorological and hydrological data from member countries of the Caribbean Meteorological Organization. It holds hourly synoptic and daily climatological data from airport stations, daily climatological data from independent climatological and agrometeorological stations, and daily and monthly rainfall, streamflow and stage data from hydrological services and water agencies. Records date back to about 1970, with some earlier rainfall. Most are held in digital databases; the institute publishes an annual two-volume summary of monthly averages and extremes and annual Barbados rainfall summaries. Coverage is the member countries of the Caribbean Meteorological Organization. Access is on request to the Principal, and charges are usually made for archived data; a data inventory is linked from the page. Caveats: the data are not downloadable online, and the country list was not checked in the inventory. Simulation uses: long rainfall, streamflow and stage series for flood, drought and water supply studies of small island and coastal systems. Related records: the Canadian national water data archive HYDAT (data-canada-hydat-national-water-data-archive).
